title: The Universe is Hostile to Computers
summary: Veritasium explains how cosmic rays and other particles flip bits in computer memory, with examples including a Belgian election count error, plane incidents and game glitches. It is inspired by a RadioLab episode on bit flips.
why: Commenters link it whenever bit flips, cosmic ray errors or unexplained computer glitches come up, as a good accessible explanation.

quote.text: The Universe is Hostile to Computers" by Veritasium is good video.
